name: @zeros/web-app
description: zeros-web Cloudflare Pages project — serves app.zeros.build (hub/auth/handoff) AND zeros.build (marketing SPA) from one deployment via host-based routing in functions/_middleware.ts. Standalone npm package (NOT a pnpm workspace member). Marketing is built inside npm run build (assemble-marketing.mjs standalone-installs website/marketing from its own pnpm-lock.yaml — CF Builds UI has no separate Install command).

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 pages dev dist --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1 --compatibility-date=2026-07-10 --kv SESSIONS --binding MARKETING_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost
scripts.dev:app: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 pages dev dist --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1 --compatibility-date=2026-07-10 --kv SESSIONS
